info.name: Shellafood Customer API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Shellafood Customer App

Base URL: https://shellafood.com
API Versions: v1, v2

⚠️ IMPORTANT - How to Use:
1. FIRST: Login using "Login - Manual" or "Login - OTP" endpoint
2. Token will be automatically saved to {{auth_token}} variable
3. All authenticated endpoints will use the saved token automatically

🔧 CLOUDFLARE BYPASS (If getting SSL/Connection errors):
If you're experiencing SSL or connection issues through Cloudflare, you can bypass it:

Option 1: Direct IP Access (Recommended for Testing)
1. Change {{base_url}} variable from "https://shellafood.com" to:
   - http://178.16.137.215 (HTTP, bypasses SSL)
   - OR https://178.16.137.215 (if origin has SSL)
2. Add Host header to every request:
   - Header: Host
   - Value: shellafood.com
   This bypasses Cloudflare and hits origin directly.

Option 2: Fix Cloudflare SSL Mode
1. Go to Cloudflare Dashboard → SSL/TLS → Encryption mode
2. Change from "Flexible" to "Full" (or vice versa if origin has no SSL)
   - "Full" = Cloudflare expects valid SSL on origin
   - "Flexible" = Cloudflare accepts HTTP from origin (less secure)

Important Headers:
- Host: shellafood.com (Required if using direct IP bypass)
- X-localization: ar | en (Language)
- moduleId: string (Module ID, e.g., "3" for grocery/hyper)
- zoneId: JSON array string (e.g., "[2]" or "[2,4,3,5]")
- X-Response-Mode: minimal | standard (for list vs detail views)
- Authorization: Bearer {token} (Auto-added for authenticated endpoints after login)

Real Test Data:
- Store IDs: 1, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 1915, 1887, 1986, 1920, 1976, 219
- Module ID: 3 (grocery/hyper)
- Zone IDs: [2,4,3,5] or [2]
- Language: ar (Arabic)

request.description:
Add item to cart

⚠️ REQUIRED FIELDS:
- item_id: Item ID (integer)
- quantity: Quantity (integer, min: 1)
- model: "Item" or "ItemCampaign" (string) - REQUIRED
- price: Item price (numeric) - REQUIRED - Get from item details endpoint first
- variation: Array of variations (optional)
- add_on_ids: Array of add-on IDs (optional)
- add_on_qtys: Array of add-on quantities (optional)
- guest_id: Guest ID if not authenticated (string)

💡 TIP: Get item price from "Item Details" endpoint first, then use that price here.
